SPIRE1-IRONCLAD.title: StS1 - Ironclad
SPIRE1-IRONCLAD.description: The Ironclad from Slay the Spire 1. A weathered soldier, last of a fallen order, who trades life for raw power - heavy strikes, brutal exhausts, and stacking Strength.
SPIRE1-IRONCLAD.goldMonologue: The coin buys blood before it buys peace.
SPIRE1-IRONCLAD.cardsModifierDescription: Adds Ironclad cards to card rewards and shops.
SPIRE1-SILENT.title: StS1 - Silent
SPIRE1-SILENT.description: The Silent from Slay the Spire 1. A deadly huntress who outmaneuvers her foes with poison, shivs, and a deck that flows through the discard pile.
SPIRE1-SILENT.goldMonologue: Gold buys information, and information buys victory.
SPIRE1-SILENT.cardsModifierDescription: Adds Silent cards to card rewards and shops.
SPIRE1-DEFECT.title: StS1 - Defect
SPIRE1-DEFECT.description: The Defect from Slay the Spire 1. An automaton of metal and stolen magic, channeling Orbs of Lightning, Frost, and Darkness to master the battlefield.
SPIRE1-DEFECT.goldMonologue: Gold buys the parts I need.
SPIRE1-DEFECT.cardsModifierDescription: Adds Defect cards to card rewards and shops.
